caption: The drawing contains two main elements placed on a light beige background. At the top center, there is a sketch of a jar with a simple black outline, featuring scalloped decoration near the neck, and the word “CONSERVATION” (partially legible, possibly “CONSERVATORY” or similar) written across the middle. The jar sketch is contained within a loosely bordered rectangle that is slightly tilted to the left. Below the jar, closer to the bottom of the page, is a horizontally oriented rectangular composition filled with a solid brown color. Inside this brown rectangle, aligned near the top, there are six semicircular forms colored in blue with some brown blending, and each semicircle has a small black dot near its top center. The objects are arranged in a line and have outlines that separate each shape. Both primary components are visually separated by significant negative space on the page.
title: Jar
